text:
emma (AE): FYI customer (BigRetailCo) pushed back in the SIG: they want explicit CAIQ language for tenant isolation + KMS ownership across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Also asking how that changes POC pricing. Any quick phrasing we can share?

raj (SE): Short answer: we split responsibilities by deployment mode. Hosted = Redwood managed KMS and logical isolation; Dedicated = Redwood manages infra but customer can BYOK for KMS; Private = customer-managed KMS/network. Will draft tidy lines.

olivia (Security): I can draft CAIQ responses. Key ask: include evidence types (architecture diagram, SOC2 page, KMS attestation steps). Also call out encryption key custody for Dedicated (BYOK option) vs Hosted (managed keys).

matt (Solutions): POC/pricing note: if customer wants BYOK + tenant-specific HSM for Dedicated, add a non-recurring setup fee (~$8k) + monthly surcharge for reserved HSM capacity. For Private on-prem, pricing depends on footprint — we should ask target QPS and retention.

emma (AE): customer wants sample text today to paste into the questionnaire. can we give short bullets per control and a one-paragraph ownership statement?

olivia (Security): Suggested CAIQ snippet (short):
```
- Control: Data Isolation / Multi-Tenancy
  Response: Redwood provides logical tenant isolation via per-customer namespaces, RBAC, and strict tenant-scoped keying. For Hosted deployments, Redwood manages encryption keys and applies tenant-scoped access controls. For Dedicated deployments, customers may elect BYOK (customer-supplied keys) with network isolation at the GPU pool level. For Private deployments (VPC/on-prem), customers control key material and network boundaries; Redwood's control plane can be deployed into the customer VPC with limited provisioning access.
  Evidence: tenant-isolation-arch.pdf, SOC2 report section 4, tenant-config export (redwood-admin).

- Control: Encryption Key Management
  Response: Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys; key rotation and key access logs provided. Dedicated: BYOK supported via customer KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM) or Redwood-hosted keys per contract. Private: customer-managed KMS/HSM.
  Evidence: KMS-rotation-policy.pdf, kms-access-logs-sample.csv
```

raj (SE): +1 to Olivia's wording. Minor tweak: include a line about audit access: "Customer access to logs and key usage events is available for Dedicated and Private deployments."

emma (AE): great. I'll paste this into the CAIQ and send to the customer. Matt — can you follow up on the estimated POC cost delta and give a short bullet for the SOW?

matt (Solutions): Yep. I'll send a pricing worksheet by EOD. For the SOW: add BYOK setup item, dedicated HSM surcharge (if requested), and 2-week extended run for integration tests.

olivia (Security): Also flag: if they require HSM attestation (FIPS/SOC3), that'll push lead time ~3 weeks. Noted in thread. :warning:

redwood-bot: Uploaded file tenant-isolation-arch.pdf (link: https://redwood.example.com/diagrams/tenant-isolation-arch.pdf)

emma (AE): Thanks team — I'll reply to the customer with the CAIQ snippets and the bot diagram link. Will loop back after pricing worksheet from Matt. :white_check_mark:
